subject: Junior Estimator, Infrastructure Services SA, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role with Infrastructure Services in Mile End, advertised on SEEK. The ad says you'd still like to hear from people who don't meet every criterion, so I'll be plain about where I stand.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities alongside road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, so reviewing drawings and specifications and pricing quantities from them is familiar work. My civil construction experience is 11 months on site in the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, reviewing drawings, doing inspections, tracking procurement and materials, and coordinating with suppliers and subcontractors.

I haven't worked in an estimating role or used Benchmark yet, and I use Word, Excel and PowerPoint. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk with the Sales and Estimating Manager about the role.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Junior Estimator, Infrastructure Services
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role with Infrastructure Services in Mile End, advertised on SEEK and on your careers site. Pricing bids for state government, local government and civil contractors across SA and NT, as the ad describes, is exactly the work I'd like to learn estimating on. The ad says you would still like to hear from people who are not sure they meet every criterion, so I will be plain about where I stand.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities alongside road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads road and pavement guides. Reviewing drawings and specifications and pricing the quantities in them is familiar work from that study, and the Austroads pavement work is the closest I have come to road surfacing. Before the diploma I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019.

My civil construction experience is 11 months on site in the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings and checked the work against them, carried out inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors on pricing, deliveries and site issues, which is the supplier side of your pricing requests.

I have not worked in an estimating role or used Benchmark yet; I use Word, Excel and PowerPoint. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk with the Sales and Estimating Manager about the role and what the first year would look like.

checklist: Open the Fulton Hogan Workday advert (Junior Estimator, requisition R26516, Mile End): https://fultonhogan.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Fultonhogan/job/Mile-End/Estimator-Senior-Estimator_R26516-1 (the SEEK ad 94850442 links out to it) and press Apply.
Create or log in to the careers profile and attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter).
Answer the portal questions honestly: no estimating role yet, 485 visa to December 2027, open to discussing relocation to Adelaide (decide your real answer first).
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website".
notes: Junior estimating role; the ad lists civil construction field experience (Marc has 11 months), Microsoft Office (yes), Benchmark "highly regarded" and 12 months estimating "ideal" (both gaps, disclosed). Interstate: Adelaide relocation is Marc's call. Contact research (28 Sep 2026): Fulton Hogan publishes no SA estimating or infrastructure manager and no individual business email; only info@fultonhogan.com (not stated to take applications). The advert lives on Workday as requisition R26516 (posted 24 Sep, closes 24 Oct 2026). Portal route only.
